subject: general
question:
The Gupta family spends their monthly income on different heads as shown in the following pie chart.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fd977124042c2c40a04f393dc10ab865d3e5108fe0448ba001cbca2d91e8b49e.png] 

What is the central angle of the combined section for House Rent and Savings?
solution:
House rent = 16%, and saving = 14%

Total house rent and savings

⇒ 16 + 14 = 30%

According to the question,

Central angle

⇒ (30/100) × 360

⇒108° 

**∴ The central angle of the combined section for House Rent and Savings is 108° **
